cohort: The participants are children whose birth data was extracted from Finnish administrative records to analyze the long-term effects of birth mode on health.
finding: Avoidable, unplanned C-sections increase the risk of asthma in children but do not affect other immune-mediated disorders previously associated with C-sections.
mod_finding: Avoidable, unplanned C-sections are linked to an increased risk of asthma in children.
